responsibility: This option-definition file declares the SPARC backend’s command-line options and target variables. It defines feature toggles such as -mvis*, -m64/-m32, floating-point and ABI controls, CPU/tuning and code-model enums, memory-model selection, and erratum workaround switches, supplying the generated option parsing tables and target mask wiring that sparc.cc and the target headers use to configure SPARC compilation behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition file for the SPARC port, listing -m switches, enums, masks, and target variables that drive generated option parsing, unlike sparc.cc which consumes option state in backend code, sparc.h which exposes compile-time target macros, and sparc.md which maps RTL to instructions.
